blacklistabilityReview.evidence: avUSD resolves Upstream under the FreezeWatch published-reserve-composition test, with medium confidence in issuer reporting rather than an assertion of independent reserve assurance. Avalanche is the material native deployment (98.6001% of campaign circulating supply). At Avalanche block 97945563, hash 0x29e60db7db9bda6ca6b0722c948d3ccc38add149f5ec84df69d30844a5a0cc40, 2026-10-19T06:36:08Z, token 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346 has owner 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb, 6253 bytes of runtime and zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots. Routescan verifies a non-proxy AvUSD inheriting ordinary ERC20Burnable/ERC20Permit/Ownable2Step; minters are owner-settable but mint-only, and burnFrom spends holder allowance. There is no upgrade dispatch, blacklist/denylist, holder-seizure function, transfer pause, or arbitrary-holder-capable burner role. No parent is declared. The official AvantMintingV2 0xcb43139e90f019624e3b76c56fb05394b162a49c is an active minter (minters(address)=true) and avantcoin() binds it to avUSD. Its redemption is privileged operator settlement of a holder-signed, allowance-backed order; its source contains no per-benefactor blacklist or whitelist. Global maxRedeem and disableMintRedeem controls are protocol-global switches, not holder-facing controls, and are not a demonstrated named-holder gate. Monad is sub-threshold: at Monad block 114685655, hash 0xc294d739e56506c68bdf2593ff9ff122da7e18e38fc63ba928b34ad21a9de5f6, 2026-10-19T06:37:37Z, totalSupply is 1682614.574735634101695581, consistent with the campaign's 1.3999%; getBurners/getMinters each enumerate official CCIP pool 0x4235afa8073d6cd8abddd23a080c1ed29978eb76. The earlier figure 22557061.017238751176916589 at Monad 114681892 is incorrect: an independent read at that exact old pin also returns 1682614.574735634101695581. The issuer API's October13 whole asset book is $971247165.1163619 gross against $849088549.9286268 financing liabilities and $122158630.0625165 NAV. The four qualifying core holdings total $947303869.10372475, or 97.53478858% of gross assets, without assigning the remaining $23943296.01263715 favorably. Self savUSD ($9.300609902020621) stays in the denominator and is excluded from the numerator. USDe independently qualifies: https://app.ethena.fi/api/collateral-breakdown currently shows $2924053250 of $4687310015 in liquid issuer stablecoins, custodial crypto basis, institutional lending with qualified-custodian/triparty collateral, and RWA funds, a conservative 62.38233103% terminal issuer/custodian floor. https://docs.ethena.fi/backing-custody-and-security/backing-asset-custody.md and https://docs.ethena.fi/backing-assets/institutional-lending.md establish those custody arrangements. The whole published USDe position is counted categorically at full share under the collateral rule. Maple's own legal disclosures identify syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT as claims on separate institutional loan portfolios managed/issued by Maple International Operations SPC: https://docs.maple.finance/legal/syrupusdc-product-disclosures-and-disclaimers.md and https://docs.maple.finance/legal/syrupusdc-and-syrupusdt-risks.md ; they qualify as fund-manager/fund claims, not because of an unsupported one-to-one USDC/USDT reserve assumption. Even assigning all financing liabilities against the four qualifying assets leaves an 80.39982040% qualifying floor relative to reported NAV. Assets minus liabilities differs from NAV by $14.8747814; the discrepancy is not favorably allocated. A diagnostic pro-rating of USDe by 62.38233103% gives 67.65640944% of gross assets, still >50%, but removes the positive worst-case net-NAV floor; the primary categorical published-book metric is binding. Exact per-wallet receipt/escrow joins, legal debt-priority/tranche allocation, and an independent reserve-to-liability attestation remain unavailable. Avant's audit page describes contract/OPSEC audits, not a reserve attestation. These limitations prevent treating this as an audited holder-level NAV composition or updating the score-bearing reserves sidecar; they do not turn the published asset-book measurement into zero or establish No. Primary context: https://docs.avantprotocol.com/yield-strategies-and-revenue/yield-generation.md ; https://docs.avantprotocol.com/security/risk-management.md ; https://docs.avantprotocol.com/security/contract-and-opsec-audits.md . Verified token/minting sources: https://api.routescan.io/v2/network/mainnet/evm/43114/etherscan/api?module=contract&action=getsourcecode&address=0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346 and the same endpoint for 0xcb43139e90f019624e3b76c56fb05394b162a49c. RPCs: https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc and https://rpc.monad.xyz; pin hashes were re-read and matched.

oracleRisk.summary: The native Avalanche avUSD contract is an owner-administered ERC-20 with an authorized-minter map, not a collateralized-debt engine: its verified source has no price-feed, borrower collateral-health, or forced-liquidation logic.

branchApplicability.rationale: Avant documents avUSD as an Avalanche-native USDC mint and redemption asset. At Avalanche C-Chain block 90331106, the verified non-proxy avUSD contract exposes ERC-20 operations and owner-managed minter authorization, but no oracle, debt-position, collateral-health, or liquidation function. The PriceStorage documented for the separate avUSDx junior token does not establish a CDP oracle branch for avUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: avUSD is Avalanche-native and has five documented CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 representations verified at pinned 2026-10-01 blocks. The Avant admin directly holds mint/burn roles on Ethereum and Linea representations; Base, Berachain and Monad currently enumerate only their documented pool. Pool versions do not establish every authorized ramp or verifier configuration, and issuer CCIP/LayerZero wording does not identify an avUSD OFT deployment.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: avUSD is issued on Avalanche through AvantMintingV2 (verified mint-authority review 2026-07-14); cross-chain movement runs via Chainlink CCIP with a LockRelease pool 0xD4fe4186c4A7b089eb849d57b43C5F6a3d3BcCbe on the Avalanche side.

Chainlink CCIP burn-mint representation of Avalanche-native avUSD; the ethereum token's CCIP pool 0x81B72171642FaB457aa815C0B8412A22B63A6aF8 reports typeAndVersion 'BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1' (read 2026-07-19). Token owner/CCIP admin is the Avant admin EOA 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb (MPC-custodied per Avant secure-asset-management docs); message validation is the Chainlink DON plus Risk Management Network.
